% Where a table sits, as in the PDF: in a paragraph, at its indent or
% where \centering or \raggedleft puts it; in an l, c, or r cell, where the
% cell's alignment puts it; a longtable, where \LTleft and \LTright put it.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{array,longtable,tabularx}
\begin{document}
A paragraph before the tables, long enough to wrap onto a second line, so
that the left margin and the indent show.

\begin{tabular}{|l|l|}
    \hline
    A table that starts a paragraph & b \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

Text before \begin{tabular}{|l|}\hline in the line\\\hline\end{tabular} and text after, in one paragraph.

\noindent\begin{tabular}{|l|}
    \hline
    After a noindent \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{|p{3cm}|c|r|}
    \hline
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}\hline in a p cell\\\hline\end{tabular} &
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}\hline in a c cell\\\hline\end{tabular} &
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}\hline in an r cell\\\hline\end{tabular} \\
    \hline
    A wide cell, long enough to wrap onto lines & a much wider c cell & a much wider r cell \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{center}
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}
        \hline
        In center \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
\end{center}

\begin{flushright}
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}
        \hline
        In flushright \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
\end{flushright}

{\centering
\begin{tabular}{|l|}
    \hline
    After centering \\
    \hline
\end{tabular}\par}

\begin{table}[h]
    \centering
    \begin{tabular}{|l|}
        \hline
        In a centered float \\
        \hline
    \end{tabular}
    \caption{A float}
\end{table}

\begin{longtable}{|l|}
    \hline
    A longtable \\
    \hline
\end{longtable}

{\setlength\LTleft{0pt}\setlength\LTright{\fill}
\begin{longtable}{|l|}
    \hline
    A longtable at the left \\
    \hline
\end{longtable}}

\begin{longtable}[r]{|l|}
    \hline
    A longtable at the right \\
    \hline
\end{longtable}

\noindent\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{|X|X|}
    \hline
    A tabularx & at the line's width \\
    \hline
\end{tabularx}

A paragraph after the tables.
\end{document}
